summary: 20 out of 255 tests failed (7.8% failure rate). Test isolation issues cause unreliable results (17 items pollute tests expecting empty state). Shell escaping bugs in E2E tests (special characters break commands). ID extraction regex doesn't match truncated IDs. Implementation bugs persist: list filtering still shows completed items, remove command doesn't persist deletions, error messages go to wrong stream.

failedChecks.name: test_code_bug: test_isolation_missing
failedChecks.message: Tests don't isolate properly - 17 items appear in tests expecting empty state. Each test should use unique temp directories or clean up between runs.

failedChecks.name: test_code_bug: shell_escaping_broken
failedChecks.message: E2E tests fail with special characters (backticks, emojis) due to unescaped shell arguments. Error: '/bin/sh: -c: unexpected EOF while looking for matching `'

failedChecks.name: test_code_bug: id_regex_mismatch
failedChecks.message: Tests use match(/\d{13}/) but CLI shows truncated IDs (177401322...). Pattern should match truncated format or tests should parse full ID.

failedChecks.name: test_code_bug: wrong_test_expectations
failedChecks.message: Tests expect specific counts ('총 3개') in polluted shared state. Workflow tests make invalid assumptions about state.

failedChecks.name: test_code_bug: help_command_test_invalid
failedChecks.message: Test calls 'add --help' but this command doesn't exist. Should test root --help or fix CLI to support per-command help.

failedChecks.name: implementation_bug: list_filtering_broken
failedChecks.message: Completed todos still visible with default 'list' command despite previous fix. Test 'should hide completed todos by default' fails.

failedChecks.name: implementation_bug: remove_persistence_failed
failedChecks.message: Remove command doesn't persist - deleted item still appears in list. Test 'should remove todo from list' fails.

failedChecks.name: implementation_bug: error_stream_confusion
failedChecks.message: CLI writes error messages to stderr but integration tests check stdout. Tests expect '✗' symbols and error text in stdout but get empty string.
